name: Crossroad
spec: yellow diamond with a black plus-shaped cross symbol
meaning: A four-way intersection ahead; watch for crossing traffic.

snippets.back: At an uncontrolled crossroad, slow down and account for unmarked pedestrian crosswalks as well as motor vehicles.
A LEFT LANE MUST TURN LEFT sign means traffic in the left lane has to turn left at the intersection ahead.

Yellow warnings preview wet slipperiness, merging traffic, divided-highway shifts, two-way traffic, ending lanes, signals ahead, crossings, added lanes, crossroads, stop or yield ahead, curves, windings.
The school bus stop rule applies on your side of the road, the opposite side or at an intersection ahead, unless a median or other physical barrier separates you from the bus.
A crossroads warning announces another road crossing ahead and the possibility of cross traffic and controls.
A crossroad warning calls for attention to crossing vehicles and any regulatory signs or signals.
Curve plates for bends, sharp hooks, S-curves, and windings all order slower speeds without passing, and crossroads order left-right scans.
A crossroad warning means another road intersects the highway ahead.
